This record therefore contributes custody/availability data to that lane and defines nothing else.

lane_reference.gap_this_record_fills: CANDIDATES.md names candidate repositories but pins none of them: a search for 40-hex commit identifiers over that file returns zero matches. Without pinned commits the lane's S1/S3 graph extraction is not reproducible. This record pins each named repository at an observed HEAD.

repository_pins.method: git ls-remote https://github.com/<slug> HEAD, 2026-08-29. No clone, no checkout, no build: zero bytes of repository content were fetched to this machine.
repository_pins.note: These are observed HEADs at pin time, offered as reproducible anchors. They are not a selection: CANDIDATES.md chose the repositories, not this record.

C2_rtptorrent.title: RTPTorrent: An Open-source Dataset for Evaluating Regression Test Prioritization
C2_rtptorrent.integrity_note: The record publishes MD5 only. Whoever completes the download must compute a SHA-256 locally and record it before any arm output is read; MD5 is transport sanity, not tamper evidence. This mirrors the same rule the ORION-13 OAEI licence manifest applies to bench23.
C2_rtptorrent.why_not_downloaded_here: Issue #1695 records this 5.0 GB payload as already downloading on billy-old with md5 verification. Downloading it again here would duplicate in-flight work, and this machine has a prior ENOSPC incident that halted a session. The published MD5 above is supplied precisely so the in-flight billy-old download can be verified against an authoritative source.
C2_rtptorrent.size_cross_check: 5016963482 bytes = 5.0 GB, consistent with the size stated in issue #1695.

not_claimed: No graph was extracted, no build was run, no test was executed, no arm was scored.
No judgement is offered on whether these repositories satisfy the T1/T2/T3 authoritativeness tiers defined in CANDIDATES.md; that adjudication belongs to lane #1695.
Reachability at pin time is not a claim that historical commits are buildable. CANDIDATES.md records historical-commit bit-rot as a kill risk, and that risk is untested here.
